changelog.summary: feat(license-intelligence): CloudShield License Intelligence & Security Value Realization Module
details: 5-Layer Value Realization Engine: Entitlement -> Assignment -> Service Plan -> Configuration/Policy Coverage -> Telemetry Evidence
14 Canonical Statuses for granular security and license gap classification
Continuous Feed Monitor: Automated monthly SHA-256 hash checks of Microsoft CDN Enterprise and SMB comparison PDFs
Persona-based licensing audit: Executive, Sec/IT Admin, Finance, HR, Dev, Frontline, Guest, Service Account, Inactive User
Duplicate and prerequisite checks: E5+E3, E5+E5 Security, SMB Premium+Standard, add-ons without base plans, SMB 300 seat cap
Azure Consumption Model separation: Defender for Cloud workloads isolated from seat-based SKUs
20-section comprehensive monthly health-check report generator (HTML and vector PDF)
Zero Fake Financial ROI: Elimination of speculative financial claims; posture and seat realization focus
Database migration 005: 5 new tables for inventory, user profiles, value summaries, reconciliations, and snapshots
REST API endpoints with fail-closed RBAC (licenses:view, licenses:manage) and Portal UI integration

changelog.author: CloudShield Security Architecture & Reporting Team
changelog.summary: feat(repositioning): Strategic repositioning to Security Reporting & Managed Services Visibility Platform
details: Product repositioning: Transitioned from broad SOC/SIEM concepts to dedicated Microsoft Security Reporting & Managed Services Visibility Platform
Comprehensive Purview ecosystem coverage: DLP, Information Protection, Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance, and DSPM
Defender workload reporting: Endpoint (MDE), Office 365 (MDO), Identity (MDI), Cloud Apps (MDCA), Cloud (MDC), and Intune
Zero Trust Security Remediation: OIDC Authorization Code Flow with PKCE S256, RS256 JWKS token validation, HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookies, token removal from URL & localStorage
Tenant isolation & Report Provenance: Centralized registry-backed report downloads (/api/reports/{id}/download), 410 decommission of legacy endpoint, canonical path defense
Separation of Duties & JIT Elevation: Dual custody enforced, maximum 8h duration limit, production toggle guard
Single-replica pilot protection: Container Apps scale lock to 1 replica and SQLite WAL mode concurrency protection

changelog.summary: feat(enterprise-ga): migration 002 time-series trends db, bilingual tr/en reporting, credential health lifecycle, and customer self-service tenant isolation
details: Database Migration 002: SQLite tables tenant_historical_metrics & tenant_credential_health with indexes
Authoritative 12-Month Time-Series Telemetry Engine: dynamic Page 2 trajectory rendering across MDE, MDO, Purview, Intune, Consolidated
Full Multilingual Support: dynamic Turkish (TR) and English (EN) report generation in vector HTML and print-ready PDF
CustomerViewer Self-Service Portal Mode: strict tenant isolation wall preventing cross-tenant leakage (403 Forbidden)
Key Vault & App Registration Credential Lifecycle Tracking: expiration countdown badges and pre-flight health diagnostics
Interactive 12-Month Trends Modal in Web UI with KPI metrics and chronological trajectory table
100% Quality Gate Validation: 59/59 Comprehensive QA, 54/54 Unit Tests, and 6/6 Semantic Quality Gates (10.0/10.0 score)
